mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.2 percentage points in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a sell-off in equities, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises by >0.2pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based supply-side slowdown, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both INDPRO and HOUST decline for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 > 3.0% annualized), a decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals a weakening consumer sector that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS declines by >0.5% in a month during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS has increased for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates a contraction in the housing sector and overall economic activity, which triggers a short-term equity sell-off, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and GDPC1 decline for 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO growth rate below 1.0% annualized), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a worsening supply shock that reduces corporate output and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO declines by >0.5% in a month and INDPRO growth rate is below 1.0% annualized.
